title: One slab is globally excluded and the optimizer theorem remains withheld on twenty-five boxes
next_gate: Replace coarse Hessian boxes with cancellation-preserving Taylor or exact rational enclosures on the 25 retained boxes; close the eight slab-two and seventeen slab-three boxes, including every exposed face and corner, before global optimizer admission.
scope_guard: K1791-K1794 prove a large exact contraction and complete slab-one exclusion. Coarse direct Hessian intervals were too wide to preserve Fisher cancellations, degree eleven exceeded the measured symbolic inversion budget, and neither limit is evidence for the global theorem.
